note: Shoshone NF, Wapiti RD, on the north side of the Buffalo Bill Scenic Byway (US-14/16/20) about 28 mi W of Cody, beside the North Fork of the Shoshone River and the historic Wapiti Ranger Station. Sites among cottonwood and juniper; bear boxes. No horses. --Claude
summary: FS and rec.gov current. First-come only (rec.gov listing is Not Reservable), $20 non-electric / $30 electric (doubles $40/$60), cash or check, 16-day limit, Senior/Access 50% on single sites. 40 sites (21 electric 15/30 A), 50-ft spurs (stored 35 -> 50). Riverfront goes down to riverview (lead): the loops sit ~50 m behind a continuous cottonwood band. Phone empty -> (307) 527-6921.
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard; lead to DOWNGRADE riverfront -> riverview): the North Fork of the Shoshone is a river here (~35-45 m of open channel), but every site sits behind a continuous cottonwood band. Nearest sites on imagery: 19 (44.46673,-109.62395) ~50 m from the south bank, 17 (44.46681,-109.62338) ~48 m, 23 (44.46646,-109.62498) and 25 (44.46646,-109.62540) ~55 m, 28 (44.46655,-109.62663) ~35-40 m - all through the continuous riparian tree band, with the loop road between for 17/19. No site has open ground to the water. Stored evidence ('scattered cottonwoods (not a continuous screen)') is contradicted by the 130-m frame. Not --AWH. Rec.gov's own wording is 'along the North Fork'; the catalog has no Proximity-to-Water tags. Default down: riverview (filtered view through the trees).

STATUS: FS 'Closed for the 2026 season' (page updated 2026-11-02) is the end-of-season notice (Elk Fork's page reads 'Closed for the season'); no forest alert closes the campground. No status written.
SEASON: neither page states open/close dates; rec.gov's 2027 rate season is 05-09..09-27 but the campground is not reservable, so no season written.
SITE COUNT: FS '41 campsites'; rec.gov description and catalog 40 (1-21 electric, 22-40 non-electric). Written 40.
ELECTRIC: rec.gov says '15 amp and 30 amp'; catalog attribute says 15. Written 30 per the description.
PHONE: empty -> (307) 527-6921 (FS contact, Clarks Fork, Greybull and Wapiti Ranger Districts; rec.gov facility phone, 'not for reservations').
Websites current: FS r02 page 200; rec.gov 234606 live but not reservable (kept, it carries the site catalog).
Pin 44.46558,-109.62421 sits at the entrance fork ~70-80 m S of the site centroid (~44.4662,-109.6245) - no move.

LEAD (weak): Elk Fork Campground (FS Shoshone, 44.46252,-109.62893, ~1 km W) is not in the DB. FS: 'Horse corrals and trailer parking are available. Maximum spur 22 feet.' The 22-ft spur passes under the 2026-10-20 ruling, but the horse rule may apply - for the reviewer; not vetted.
